silence_detection.docs:
**boolean**: Enable silence detection. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

wake_word.docs:
**string**: The wake word that was used to trigger the voice assistant when using on-device wake word such as [Micro Wake Word](https://esphome.io/components/micro_wake_word/).

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

start.docs: Listens for one voice command then stops.

start_continuous.docs: Start listening for voice commands. This will start listening again after the response audio has finished playing. Some errors will stop the cycle. Call `voice_assistant.stop` to stop the cycle.

connected.docs: Returns true if the voice assistant is currently connected to Home Assistant.

is_running.docs: Returns true if the voice assistant is currently running.

auto_gain.docs:
**dBFS**: Auto gain level to apply to the assist pipeline. Between 0dBFS and 31dBFS inclusive. Defaults to 0 (disabled).

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

conversation_timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: How long to wait before resetting the `conversation_id` sent to the voice assist pipeline, which contains the context of the current assist pipeline. Defaults to `300s`.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

media_player.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The [media_player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/) to use to output the response. Cannot be used with `speaker` above.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

micro_wake_word.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The [micro_wake_word](https://esphome.io/components/micro_wake_word/) component used for wake word detection. Configuring this allows Home Assistant to change which wake word model is enabled.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

microphone.docs:
**[Microphone Source Configuration](https://esphome.io/components/microphone#config-microphone-source) or list of them**: The [microphone](https://esphome.io/components/microphone/) settings to use for input. A single source may be provided directly, or up to two sources may be provided as a list. When two sources are configured, audio from both is streamed to Home Assistant; see [Second microphone channel](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#second-microphone-channel) below.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

noise_suppression_level.docs:
**integer**: The noise suppression level to apply to the assist pipeline. Between 0 and 4 inclusive. Defaults to 0 (disabled).

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_client_connected.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when Home Assistant has connected and is waiting for Voice Assistant commands.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_client_disconnected.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when Home Assistant disconnects from the Voice Assistant.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_end.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the voice assistant is finished all tasks.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_error.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the voice assistant has encountered an error. The error code and message are available to automations as the variables `code` and `message`.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_idle.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the voice assistant is idle (no other actions/states are in progress).

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_intent_end.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when intent processing ends.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_intent_progress.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when intent progress happens. The variable `x` is a non-empty string containing the streaming TTS response URL only if it is sent to the media player.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_intent_start.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when intent processing starts.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_listening.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the voice assistant microphone starts listening.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_start.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the assist pipeline is started.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_stt_end.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the voice assistant has finished speech-to-text. The resulting text is available to automations as the variable `x`.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_stt_vad_end.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when voice activity detection ends speech-to-text processing.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_stt_vad_start.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when voice activity detection starts speech-to-text processing.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_timer_cancelled.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a voice assistant timer has been cancelled. The timer is available as `timer` of type <APIStruct text="voice_assistant::Timer" path="voice_assistant::Timer" />.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_timer_finished.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a voice assistant timer has finished. The timer is available as `timer` of type <APIStruct text="voice_assistant::Timer" path="voice_assistant::Timer" />.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_timer_started.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a voice assistant timer has started. The timer is available as `timer` of type <APIStruct text="voice_assistant::Timer" path="voice_assistant::Timer" />.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_timer_tick.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the voice assistant timers tick is triggered. This is called every **1 second** while there are timers on this device. The timers are available as `timers` which is a `std::vector` (array) of type <APIStruct text="voice_assistant::Timer" path="voice_assistant::Timer" />.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_timer_updated.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a voice assistant timer has been updated (paused/resumed/duration changed). The timer is available as `timer` of type <APIStruct text="voice_assistant::Timer" path="voice_assistant::Timer" />.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_tts_end.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the voice assistant has finished text-to-speech. A URL containing the audio response is available to automations as the variable `x`.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_tts_start.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the voice assistant has started text-to-speech. The text to be spoken is available to automations as the variable `x`.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_tts_stream_end.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when audio stream (voice response) playback ends. Requires `speaker` to be configured.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_tts_stream_start.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when audio stream (voice response) playback starts. Requires `speaker` to be configured.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

on_wake_word_detected.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the assist pipeline has detected a wake word.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

speaker.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The [speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) to use to output the response. Cannot be used with `media_player` below.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

use_wake_word.docs:
**boolean**: Enable wake word on the assist pipeline. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*

volume_multiplier.docs:
**float**: Volume multiplier to apply to the assist pipeline. Must be larger than 0. Defaults to 1 (disabled).

*See also: [Voice Assistant](https://esphome.io/components/voice_assistant#configuration-variables)*
